<p align="center"><strong>Find the brass key to the attic.</strong></p>


<p align="center">A brass keyhole sits beneath a carved spider. Through the attic door, someone drags a chair into place directly opposite you.</p>

<p align="center">&quot;She cannot cross a locked threshold,&quot; Elias says. &quot;Neither can you. Find the key before she remembers which side you are on.&quot;</p>
